title: MORPH3D
subtitle: Five morphing platonic polyhedra, two-sided lighting — Mesa demos 8.0.1
_why: A second whole GLUT program on PRISM's GL after gears: two-sided lighting with one material on both faces, two lights, a glLightModel ambient. Held to Mesa by tools/gate-mesa-demos.mjs (at most 1 of 307,200 pixels per frame).
